annotations.title: Upload a video attached in the chat

description: Store a video file the user attached in this conversation as a new hosted video. Only usable when the AI app itself fills in a temporary https download_url and file_id for the attachment (ChatGPT does this). Clients that cannot supply such a URL (including Claude) must not call this tool or try to send the file contents: call start_video_upload instead, which gives the user a browser upload link. Pass the attachment as `file`. The file must be a video of at most 512 MB, and the user's plan must have room for it (the same storage rule as any upload). The transfer runs on Vidreno's side; the tool waits briefly and returns status ready (with the video and its embed code), uploading (keep calling get_upload_status with the upload_id until it is ready or failed), or an error explaining what to do instead. For files above the limit or on the user's computer, use start_video_upload.

file.description: The video file attached in the conversation.

download_url.description: Temporary download URL of the attached file (filled in by the client).

file_id.description: The client's id for the attached file.

file_name.description: The attachment's file name, when the client knows it.

mime_type.description: The attachment's media type, when the client knows it.

title.description: Title for the video; defaults to the attachment's file name.

visibility.description: Visibility of the video; default public.
